notes.title: The online live broadcast of the Wine & War is at 8:00 p.m. （gmt+8) on Oct 6
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. We will start the live broadcast of the Wine & War game at 8 p.m. （gmt+8) on October 6. Please join us.

In addition, if you like our game, please add a wish list to support us.
